## Bunker 0.3.0 – build a song, drop it better 🎬

### Songs out of patterns
- **Patterns A–D** (formerly scenes) under the orbit: + keeps what you hear, a click switches – while the beat runs it comes in on the next bar, with a clap roll before. No more bar counts and drop flashes.
- **SONG** turns your patterns into a whole track. Pick **Short** (~2 min, one drop), **Club** (~4–5 min, two drops) or **Hypnotic** (long, one big drop): Bunker plays intro, groove, break, build-up, drop and outro with your patterns and steers the energy itself. A strip above the patterns shows the parts and where you are – click one to jump there on the next bar. Jam along all the way. Works with just one pattern, too.

### A better drop
- **The build-up is made from your groove**: the kick rolls in quarters, 8ths, then 16ths, the hats run, bass and synth loop their first beat and jump an octave up – then half a beat of silence and everything hits.
- It always starts on the next bar and lasts two bars, so you know when the drop lands.
- **Drop zone on the energy fader**: push the energy to 90 or more and the build-up starts by itself. Pull it down, bring it back up slowly – and drop.

### Grooves that fit together
- Bass and synth always play the same chord, 303 lines land on chord notes, kicks never stumble, loops stay in step with the bar, the auto mode only picks sounds that suit the vibe, and the hi-hats don't double up.

### Simpler
- **MOOD** instead of key, scale and chords: Dark · Hypnotic · Deep · Sad · Euphoric (bass and synth get fitting notes), plus **Pitch** lower/higher.
- **GROOVE** instead of the swing slider: Straight · Loose · Bouncy · Shuffle.
- The vibes are a **dropdown** in the top bar next to SHUFFLE – more room for the orbit.
- No more shortcut bar at the bottom (every key is in the help), the sound status is an icon in the top bar.

### And
- **WASH** no longer booms and its tail rings out when you let go.
- `.bunker` files keep the groove and the four patterns; files from 0.2 still open.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) | `Bunker-macos-universal.zip` |
| Windows 10/11 | `Bunker-windows-x64.zip` |

The Mac app is not notarized yet: on first launch, right-click → *Open*, or *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*. Windows SmartScreen may ask once: *More info → Run anyway*.
